5096.statement: If a split finite Chevalley group has N positive roots, its maximal unipotent subgroup has q^N elements and the Steinberg degree is q^N. The N positive-root subgroups each have order q, hence their total coset count is N q^(N-1)=d(q^N)/dq.

5097.consequence: the derivative graph has exactly the full projective chamber-stabilizer symmetry
